name: agent-trace-inspector
description: Model-independent evaluation and debugging for AI-agent tool traces.

scripts.check: node --check src/evaluator.mjs && node --check src/trace-schema.mjs && node --check src/validate-trace.mjs && node --check src/rate-limit.mjs && node --check src/server.mjs && node --check src/worker-handler.mjs && node --check src/worker.mjs && node --check public/app.js && node --check scripts/smoke-check.mjs && node --check scripts/load-check.mjs && npm test && npm run evaluate
scripts.deploy:dry-run: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-production
